newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BOLSWESSANEN TO BUY TWO U.S. DAIRY FIRMS.
newsitem.headline: BOLSWESSANEN TO BUY TWO U.S. DAIRY FIRMS.

text.p: BolsWessanen said on Wednesday its U.S. dairy unit Crowley Foods had agreed to buy Penn Maid Foods of Philadelphia and Hagan Ice Cream Co near Pittsburgh.
It said the companies had combined annual sales of $66 million.
"Both acquisitions fit in with the U.S. dairy's strategy to acquire dominant regional market positions," BolsWessanen chairman Mac Zondervan told a news conference.
Penn Maid is market leader in greater Philadelphia, selling a broad variety of specialist dairy products.
It has annual sales of $50 million.
Hagan is market leader in Pittsburgh and surrounding areas with a 25 percent market share and annual sales of $16 million.
Zondervan said Hagan's production would be stopped and transferred to another factory.
